methods.description: Evaluate products or quotients before outside addition/subtraction in a positive numerical sentence, keeping remaining operations in order. Interpret grouped quantities in real-life contexts or compare several computed results using this same procedure.

Evaluate the grouped number sentence first, then use the agreed operation order for the remaining expression. Identify the first required operation, and contrast with the same positive expression without grouping.

Division and multiplication share one level; addition and subtraction share one level. Work across each level from left to right, rather than placing multiplication before division or addition before subtraction.
